title: Odoo User Guide
tagline: Use Odoo with confidence at work: the everyday tasks in Accounting, CRM, Sales and Purchase, with a downloadable user guide.
description: A practical course for employees and business users who work in Odoo every day. No technical background is needed.

Short video lessons cover the everyday tasks in four core applications: Accounting, CRM, Sales and Purchase. A downloadable user guide keeps the steps at hand while you work, a quick check follows each lesson, and a certification assessment completes the course.
learningOutcomes: Find your way around Odoo apps, menus and records
Handle everyday tasks in the Accounting app
Track leads and opportunities in CRM
Create quotations and confirm sales orders
Create requests for quotation and purchase orders
Use the user guide as a reference in your daily work
whoItsFor: Employees using Odoo for daily sales, purchasing or accounting work
Business teams that need to create consistent records and collaborate through shared workflows
Business owners who want to understand how their teams work inside Odoo
Complete beginners building a clear foundation before a role-based Odoo course
requirements: No previous Odoo or ERP experience required
Access to an Odoo instance (trial or company account)

faq.question: Is this suitable for someone with no ERP experience?
faq.answer: Yes. The course starts with how Odoo is organized before moving into each app.

faq.question: Does this course require programming?
faq.answer: No. It focuses entirely on everyday business tasks.

faq.question: What should I study next?
faq.answer: The Crash Course Odoo ERP for the bigger ERP picture, or Odoo Implementation to learn how to configure Odoo for a business.
